At low magnification, the splenic red pulp is expanded and appears hypercellular; the white pulp is atrophic (<<30942>>). High magnification of the splenic red pulp showing numerous lymphoma cells (<<30943>>).
The sinusoids of the liver are extensively involved and expanded by lymphoma cells (<<30944>>). The lymphoma cells are positive for CD3, supporting a T-cell lineage (<<30945>>).
The sinusoids of the liver are extensively involved and expanded by lymphoma cells (<<30944>>). The lymphoma cells are positive for CD3, supporting a T-cell lineage (<<30945>>).

A trephine biopsy shows hypercellularity, and sinusoids are distended by many intermediate-sized lymphoma cells (<<30949>>). The tumour cells are positive for CD3 (<<30950>>). A bone marrow aspirate smear shows many intermediate-sized lymphoma cells with agranular cytoplasm and inconspicuous nucleoli (Giemsa) (<<30946>>). Cells can be intermediate-sized to large with prominent nucleoli imparting a blastoid appearance (Giemsa) (<<30948>>).
